expected_symptom: dxc fails internally on the repro rather than diagnosing it: a trapped or thrown assert in a Debug build, an access violation or a cast-of-incompatible-type E_FAIL in a Release build. An ordinary diagnosed error would be the fix, not the symptom.
history: always-repro'd across all 20 stable releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 and main; one defect, five observed presentations
summary: Still reproduces on main (13730886e) and every stable release. An undefined cbuffer index passes TranslateCBGepLegacy's dyn_cast<Constant> and reaches getUniqueInteger(); Debug asserts, while Release builds access-violate or throw a cast failure. Across the matrix the one defect has five presentations: silent AV, messaged AV, 0x80AA001D, E_FAIL plus the build-agnostic cast marker, and the Debug assert. The self-initialisation is not required -- a plain uninitialised uint fails identically -- and FXC diagnoses both forms with X4000.
title: DXC Compiler Crash
